question: In 2025, what share of orders contained more than one item line? Compare average ordered units per order for one-line and multi-line orders; also report orders with no item line separately.

action.query:
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN i.ITEM_LINE_COUNT IS NULL THEN 'No item line' 
    WHEN i.ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 1 THEN 'One item line' 
    WHEN i.ITEM_LINE_COUNT > 1 THEN 'Multi item line' 
  END AS ORDER_TYPE,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.ORDER_ID) AS ORDER_COUNT,
  SUM(i.ITEM_QUANTITY) AS TOTAL_UNITS,
  AVG(i.ITEM_QUANTITY) AS AVG_UNITS_PER_ORDER
FROM ZOMATO_DLR.INTERMEDIATE.INT_ORDER_BASE o
LEFT JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.INTERMEDIATE.INT_ORDER_ITEM_ROLLUP i
  ON o.ORDER_ID = i.ORDER_ID
WHERE o.ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND o.ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY ORDER_TYPE
ORDER BY 
  CASE ORDER_TYPE 
    WHEN 'No item line' THEN 0 
    WHEN 'One item line' THEN 1 
    WHEN 'Multi item line' THEN 2 
  END
action.metrics: order count, average ordered units per order, by order type (no item line, one item line, multi item line)
action.group_by: order type (no item line, one item line, multi item line)

action.metrics: Order share by item line count, average ordered units per order for one-line and multi-line orders, count of orders with no item line (2025)
action.group_by: order type (no item line, one item line, multi item line)
action.answer:
In 2025, among orders with item line data: 
- 3,052,089 orders (70.01%) were multi item line orders (more than one item line), with an average of 3.484769 units per order.
- 1,307,684 orders (29.99%) were one item line orders, with an average of 1.219753 units per order.
- No orders were reported with zero item lines in the available data.

Interpretation: The majority of orders (about 70%) contained more than one item line, and these orders had a much higher average number of units per order compared to single item line orders. There were no orders without any item lines in the dataset for 2025.
